title: Jose's agents cannot fetch the key tool: pki.sgit.ai is refused by the session's network policy
detail: conductor@web-summit.jose started on 3 November in a Claude Code cloud session in Jose's account and can push to dev, but the environment's network policy refused pki.sgit.ai (00:34 UTC), so it cannot run pki-agent.mjs keygen --session and Jose stays at L3. Either Jose adds pki.sgit.ai to the environment's allowed domains (the cloud environment menu, Edit, Network access), or the team keeps a copy of pki-agent.mjs in the repository so any agent can run it from its clone.
recommend: Jose allows pki.sgit.ai now (two minutes); a vetted copy in the repository is a separate call for Dinis and security
options: Jose allows pki.sgit.ai in his environment's network settings
a copy of pki-agent.mjs in the repository for every agent
